sector: Food/cold chain (non-profit food bank, fresh fruit)
hitl_conditions: When forecast donations exceed outbound demand or refrigerated storage is unavailable, operators reschedule immediate deliveries to charities; for anomalous events they run what-if scenarios on key influencers to design and evaluate action plans.
key_finding: A time-series forecasting model in SAP Analytics Cloud (Smart Predict) on the food bank's historical donation and distribution data is framed as a continuously updated digital twin that predicts inbound donations and charity demand, letting operators reschedule deliveries and run what-if scenarios to cut fruit waste; no accuracy metrics reported.

quotes.text: As described in Figure 2, the approach uses operational data to develop a digital twin-based decision support system for fresh food inventory.
A case study of Banco Alimentare Campania Onlus (one of the Italian food banks) is used to evaluate the proposed approach.
The time series can be automated using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAP, 2022) and the model can be trained using a forecast algorithm.
The model was created and trained in the SAP Analytics Cloud using historical data from the food bank.
The use of a digital twin, on the other hand, will make it easier for food bank operators to reschedule incoming and outgoing logistics.
If the incoming donation exceeds the outbound logistics, the food bank will reschedule the immediate delivery of fruits to a charity organization according to the predictive forecast.
